## Overview

Vantage is a geopolitical catastrophe modeling tool built by a five-person team in 48 hours at the AINU Hackathon, where it placed second.

## What I Built

Contributed across architecture, pipeline implementation, and the final pitch. The system routes simulations through five domain-specific agents covering economic, military, climate, infrastructure, and political risk, then synthesizes their outputs into an interactive map layer.

## Stack

TypeScript · Next.js · OpenAI API · Minimax M2.5 · MapTiler API · WebGL

## Overview

BallWatch is an NBA analytics platform scoped through 24 user stories across four personas, including coaches, general managers, scouts, and analysts.

## What I Built

Designed a normalized 15-table MySQL schema with referential integrity, built a RESTful Flask API, and created a Streamlit dashboard with Plotly visualizations for scouting, lineup, and monitoring insights. The application is containerized with Docker Compose.

## Stack

Python · Flask · MySQL · Docker · Streamlit · Plotly

## Overview

Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline to process long-term personal Spotify data, applying temporal and behavioral analysis to surface listening patterns and preference shifts not captured by native platform insights.

## What I Built

Using the Spotify Web API and Python, I pulled years of streaming history and built a Streamlit dashboard that surfaces top genres by era, listening-time distribution, seasonal taste shifts, and artist loyalty over time.

## Stack

Python · Pandas · Spotipy · Streamlit · Plotly

## Overview

Hooper is a full-stack basketball chatbot that answers natural-language questions about NBA players, teams, and history, powered by a local LLM through Ollama with real-time response streaming.

## What I Built

Built an Express.js backend that pipes Ollama's streaming output directly to the client through server-sent events. The React front end parses the stream and renders Markdown responses incrementally as they arrive.

## Stack

Express.js · React · Ollama · Server-Sent Events · Node.js
